custody_model: First-party terms state that ownership of lent crypto transfers to Smart Lending Co., Ltd.; the exposure is unsecured and lent assets are outside statutory segregated management.
yield_source: Smart Lending states that funds are invested through selected domestic and overseas funds; this is an operator claim and not independently verified evidence of yield sustainability.
risk_notes: Current materials state ordinary 30-day lending at principle 11% annualized and premium 365-day lending at principle 13% annualized. These are issuer product terms, not verified realized returns or guarantees.
